## Answer quality: no retrieval vs dense vs hybrid + reranker

100 held-out questions; chunk size 256; generator qwen3:4b-instruct; judge qwen3:4b-instruct; BERTScore distilroberta-base (rescaled with baseline). References come from the synthetic question pool and are not always right. Judge score: correct = 1, partial = 0.5, incorrect = 0, averaged over all questions.

| Retrieval | Refused (only "I do not know") | Hedged | Judge: correct [95% CI] | partial | incorrect | Judge score | BERTScore F1 | Correct, of answered | BERTScore F1, answered | Faithful: supported / valid verdicts (attempted, unparsed) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 0 | 0 | 16 (16.0%) [10.1, 24.4] | 18 | 66 | 0.25 | 0.359 | 16.0% of 100 | 0.359 | n/a |
| dense | 40 | 2 | 32 (32.0%) [23.7, 41.7] | 16 | 52 | 0.4 | 0.236 | 53.3% of 60 | 0.478 | 50/60 (83.3%) (60, 0) |
| rerank | 31 | 4 | 34 (34.0%) [25.5, 43.7] | 20 | 46 | 0.44 | 0.279 | 49.3% of 69 | 0.466 | 59/68 (86.8%) (69, 1) |

## How far can the LLM judges be trusted?

Verdicts of the qwen3:4b-instruct judges against hand labels: correctness (correct / partial / incorrect) and faithfulness (supported / partly / unsupported).

| Labelled set | Judge | n | Labelled by | Exact agreement | Top label vs rest | Cohen's kappa | Per variant | Disagreements (label -> judge) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `judge_labels_run1.jsonl` | correctness | 36 | Claude (to be checked by the team) | 27/36 | 32/36 (correct) | 0.509 | none 9/12, dense 8/12, rerank 10/12 | partial -> incorrect: 4, partial -> correct: 3, incorrect -> partial: 1, correct -> incorrect: 1 |
| `judge_labels_run2.jsonl` | correctness | 36 | Claude, blind to the judge (to be checked by the team) | 28/36 | 28/36 (correct) | 0.64 | none 9/12, dense 9/12, rerank 10/12 | partial -> correct: 5, correct -> partial: 2, correct -> incorrect: 1 |
| `faithful_labels_run2.jsonl` | faithfulness | 16 | Claude, blind to the judge (to be checked by the team) | 12/16 | 12/16 (supported) | 0.256 | dense 6/7, rerank 6/9 | partly -> supported: 4 |

## Crafting tool, dev questions (used to tune the prompts)

Quantity questions with a number computed from Minecraft 26.3 recipe files; answers go through the full pipeline (hybrid + reranker retrieval, 5 passages).

| Variant | Correct | Accuracy [95% CI] | Called the tool | of which by the fallback |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| without tool | 0/40 | 0.0% [0.0, 8.8] | 0 | 0 |
| with tool | 38/40 | 95.0% [83.5, 98.6] | 38 | 10 |

Tool called for 0 of 40 ordinary (non-crafting) questions.

## Crafting tool, earlier runs (kept for the record)

The citation fix (the final answer cites the tool as [tool] instead of a passage) came from the demo, and the name fix from Codex's review (docs/codex_review.md), not from test errors; every test run is kept. All runs are scored with the current parser (`eval.py rescore`); the first parser took the first number anywhere and counted 4 refusals in the first run as correct. See docs/failure_analysis.md.

| File | What | With tool | Without tool | Called the tool |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tool_run1_before_fix.json` | first design: the tool offered in one prompt together with the passages | 11/40 | 3/40 | 14/40 |
| `tool_dev_before_citation_fix.json` | two-step agent before the citation fix, dev questions | 38/40 | 0/40 | 38/40 |
| `tool_run2_before_citation_fix.json` | two-step agent before the citation fix, test questions | 33/40 | 1/40 | 33/40 |
| `tool_run3_before_name_fix.json` | final agent, test questions before two generic names ("Smithing Template") were made specific | 35/40 | 1/40 | 35/40 |
